recentItems.title: UN votes to replace 450-year-old world map | 7NEWS
recentItems.description:
The United Nations General Assembly has voted to replace the traditional Mercator projection world map, which has been in use for over 450 years, with a more accurate representation of continent sizes. 

The historic map, created by Gerardus Mercator in 1569, has been criticised for distorting sizes, showing Africa as similar in size to Greenland when it is actually 14 times larger. The resolution passed with 164 votes in favour, with only the United States voting against it.

recentItems.title: Rescue brings hope for missing Australians in Nepal | 7NEWS
recentItems.description:
Two workers have been rescued from Nepal's hydropower tunnels following a disaster that left 36 Australians missing. Australian geologist and rescue specialist Arnold Dix helped pinpoint the dig site through massive boulders to locate survivors including mechanical foreman Sanjay Sah, who was attempting to evacuate others when trapped. 

Fifteen Australian disaster response experts and seven AFP identification specialists have been deployed to Kathmandu, while families including the Kowshikan relatives await news of their missing loved ones.
